notes.title: 1.0.9 Patch Notes:
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Richman 11 has its new update! This time, we bring two brand new lords “Silence” and “Sherry”, come and try!

For more details please check below:
1.Add 2 new lords “Silence” and “Sherry”.
2.Update “Snatch Property” mode, add new random buildings and optional maps.

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Richman 11 has its new update! This time, we bring 2 brand new lords for everyone, come to meet “Bear” and “Yuan”.

For more details please check below:

1.Add Classic Map “Snatch Properties” type options when creating play.
“Snatch Properties” maps (Sleepless Town, Mechanic Maze, Angel Island, Mountain City), have initial buildings on properties.

2.Add 2 new lords “Bear” and “ Yuan”.

3.Bugfixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985914/fb0ac6d9be0f8f328166f3717a88f1ce90315f88.jpg

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Bugfixes.

2. Main interface optimization.

3. Room interface optimization.

4. Optimization of function interface for some maps.

5. Optimization of character moving speed.

6. When creating a play, the default option of "Game Rounds" changes to "Time Limitation" from "No Limit", adding notification regarding "Game Rounds" in game as well. 

7. Add mechanism notification to the map "Sleepless Town".

8. Improve the graphic art of some cards.

9. Press "Tab" to check the overview of the play. 

This update will be implemented due at 11:00 AM (GMT+8), during the time, there will be short time maintenance of the servers, please be prepared, thank you.
